_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Micron Technology, Inc., including its consolidated subsidiaries, is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions.' 'We have experienced volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products which may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2017 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud only among the markets Micron sells into ('Increasingly our SSDs are being utilized in large-scale cloud environments.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'Micron Technology, Inc., including its consolidated subsidiaries, is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions.' 'We have experienced volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products which may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2017 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud only among the markets Micron sells into ('Increasingly our SSDs are being utilized in large-scale cloud environments.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.38x; +166% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.29; conservative 2yr -7%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.8%/yr (worst year FY10-FY17 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (Q3 FY18 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.7-yr ex-FY08 ex-FY09 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (FY10-FY17 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY17 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2018-06-01) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.38x (69.5% downside to Bear $17.93 / +50.2% upside to Bull $88.22) | Adj composite 2.90 vs market 2.61: gap +0.29 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +166% above the EPP floor $22.05 (5x FY18E $4.41) | Conservative 2-yr case: -7.3% total (-3.6%/yr) | At 13.3x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $77.68 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +58.2% YoY in Q2 FY18, forward revenues +38.3-40.1% (Q3 FY18 revenue guide (8-K of 2018-05-21 (updated Q3 FY18 guidance, ex.99.1))); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
